juicio: The creator has sublime success, favored by perseverance. You will receive a share of success coming from the depths underlying the events of the universe and that everything depends on the fact that one only seeks his happiness and that of others by persevering on the right path. According to the main meaning, the attributes (sublime, successful, promoter, persistent) go in pairs. For one who obtains this answer from the oracle, this means that he will receive a share of success coming from the depths underlying the events of the universe and that everything depends on the fact that one only seeks his own happiness and that of others by persevering on the right path. The specific meanings of these four attributes soon became an object of speculation. The Chinese word translated “sublime” means: “head, origin, great.” This is the reason why Confucius's explanation says: “Great is the original power of the Creator, all beings owe their beginning to him, and this power penetrates the entire sky.” This first attribute also permeates the other three. The beginning of all things remains, so to speak, in the beyond, in the form of ideas, which must go through a stage of realization. But the creator also already has the power to give shape to those ideal archetypes: that is the notion that the word “successful” expresses. This process is represented by an image of nature: “The clouds pass, the rain operates and all individual beings flow in their form.” Applied to the kingdom of man, the attributes show the noble man the path to great success: “Because he sees with great clarity the first causes and effects, he completes the six degrees in correct time and rises on them towards heaven at the opportune moment, as on six dragons.” The six degrees are the six different positions within the hexagram, represented by the image of dragons. The path of success here is the recognition and realization of the path (Tao) of the world which, like a law that runs from beginning to end, produces all phenomena conditioned by time. In this way, each degree achieved is at the same time the preparation for the next, and time is no longer an obstacle, but rather the means that allows the realization of the possible. After the act of creation has been expressed through both “sublime” and “successful” attributes, the work of preservation now appears as a continuous updating and differentiation of form. It is then translated as two expressions of the abributos of “promotion”, that is, “creating what corresponds to nature” and “persistence”, that is, being “fair and firm.” “The walk of the creator modifies beings and shapes them, until all have achieved their righteous nature, the one that is destined for them, and maintains them in accordance with great harmony and perseverance.” In the human domain, we see how the noble man confers peace and security on the world through his orderly action: “As he rises, lifting his head above the multitude of men, all regions are united in peace.” Another speculation takes the distinction of the words “sublime, successful, promoter, persistent” even further by placing them in parallel with the four cardinal virtues. “Sublimity,” which as a fundamental principle includes all other attributes, is assigned “love.” The attribute of “successful” is attributed to the customs that regulate and order the expressions of love and, consequently, ensure its success. In the term "promote" it is associated with "justice" that creates situations in which each person receives what corresponds to their nature, what is their own and what makes them happy. The attribute of “perseverance” is attributed to “wisdom” that recognizes the fixed laws of all events and that, consequently, can create lasting situations. These speculations, which already appear in one of the comments that make up the second part of the I Ching, the Wen Yen, constituted the bridge that made possible the union of the philosophy of the five degrees of transformation (elements), solidly established in the Book of Annals, with the I Ching that, based solely on a bipolar duality of positive and negative principles, has opened the door to a symbolism of numbers that has developed over time.
imagen: The movement of the sky is powerful. Thus the noble man becomes strong and tireless. Since there is only one sky, the repetition of the sign ch'ien, which has the sky as an image, means the movement of the sky. The perfect circular movement of the sky constitutes a day. The doubling of the trigram means that each day is followed by another. That gives the idea of ​​time, and simultaneously, since it is the sky itself moving with its indefatigable power, the idea of ​​a powerful period in time and beyond it, of a movement that never ceases or stops, just as one day tirelessly succeeds another day. This duration in time is the image of the power inherent in creativity. The wise man takes the example of how to make its effects lasting, strengthening them uniformly and deliberately eliminating everything that is inconvenient to common sense. Thus he becomes indefatigable, which is a quality that is acquired by regulating the field of his activities.

juicio: Receptiveness produces sublime success, favored by a mare's perseverance. If the noble man undertakes something and tries to guide, he will miss the path. But if you docilely allow yourself to be guided, then you will follow a good direction. It is favorable to find friends in the west and south, and stay away from friends in the east and north. Calm perseverance brings good fortune. The four fundamental aspects of the creative (2), “sublime success favored by perseverance”, also serve to characterize the attributes of power in its passive, receptive aspect. Here perseverance is defined more precisely, as being the perseverance of a mare. The receptive designates the spatial reality compared to the spiritual power of the creative. The horse belongs to the earth, just as the dragon belongs to the sky. The mare was chosen as a symbol because it combines the strength and lightness of the horse with the docility and devotion of the cow. The multiple forms of the earth respond to the multiple creative intentions, because the earth has the receptive power to turn them into something real. The wealth of nature lies in its power to nourish all beings, and its greatness lies in the fact that it gives them beauty and splendor. She makes all living things prosper. The Creative engenders things, but they are born thanks to nature. Applied to human affairs, the hexagram means action in accordance with the situation. The person in question is not in an independent position, but rather acts as an assistant. It means that something must be concluded. Her task does not mean that she must lead - which can only divert her from her path - but rather that she let herself be guided, such is her role. If you know how to face destiny with an attitude of acceptance, you can be sure to find the corresponding direction. The noble man allows himself to be guided; He does not go blindfolded but rather learns from the circumstances what is required of him, follows his directives, knows everything that the situation requires and gives in to destiny. When there is something that must be done well, friends and helpers are required in the hour of work and effort, once the plans of what must be done have been firmly determined. The time of work and effort is expressed by the west and the south, since it is there where the receptive opens up for the creative, in the same way that nature does in summer and autumn. If all capabilities are not mobilized, the task will not be well accomplished. Finding friends here means doing your homework. But outside of work and effort, there is also time for plans and order: for this, isolation is necessary. The East symbolizes the place where the master's orders are received and the North where one realizes what has been done. There you need to be alone and be objective. This sacred hour must not be disturbed by hatred or favoritism.
imagen: The condition of the earth is receptive abandonment. The noble man of vast nature sustains the outside world. In the same way that there is only one heaven, there is only one earth. While in the first hexagram the doubling of the strong trigram means the temporal duration, in the second, the doubling of the weak trigram means the extension of space and the firmness with which the earth supports everything that lives and moves on it. The earth, in its self-denial, bears good and evil without exception. Thus the noble man transforms his character into vast, solid and resistant to be able to carry and support men and things.

juicio: The initial difficulty produces sublime success, promoting with perseverance. Do nothing. It is advantageous to hire assistants. Gestation times are surrounded by difficulties. It's like a first birth. But these difficulties arise from the wealth of factors struggling to acquire form. Everything is in motion: so, despite the present danger, there is the possibility of great success if you persevere. When fate presents itself in such an aspect of certain moments, everything remains shapeless and dark. That is why we must wait, since any premature gesture can lead to failure. It is also of great importance not to be alone. One must have auxiliaries to triumph with them over chaos. But that does not mean that one should remain passive just watching the events, but rather that one should get to work, encouraging and directing everything.
imagen: Clouds and thunder: the image of initial difficulty. This is how the noble man acts, unraveling and putting in order. Clouds and thunder are already represented by definite arrangements on the lines. That means that, in the chaos of the initial difficulty, order is already present. Therefore, in those early moments, the noble man must articulate and order the confused abundance, as one separates the silk threads from a tangled cocoon to bind them into skeins. To recognize oneself in the infinite, one must distinguish and unite.

juicio: Youthful madness triumphs. It is not I who looks for the inexperienced young man but rather he who must seek my help. In the first oracle, I report. If he asks two or three times, he pesters. If you bother, I won't give you information. Perseverance is advantageous. In youth, madness is not dangerous. You can succeed despite it, as long as you find an experienced teacher and maintain a respectful attitude toward him. This means, first of all, being aware of your own inexperience, and seeking a teacher. Only this modesty and this interest guarantee the necessary receptivity of the spirit that is expressed in a respectful acceptance of the teacher. That is why the teacher must wait peacefully until he is called, but not offer himself. Only in this way will teaching bear fruit in a timely manner and in a convenient manner. The answer given by the teacher to the disciple's questions must be clear and precise like the one that a consultant from the oracle wishes to obtain. Then it will be received as a solution to the doubt and also as a decision. Additional questions caused by distrust or lack of reflection only serve to annoy the teacher. The best thing will be to maintain silence about them, in the same way that the oracle gives a single answer and refuses any question arising from doubt. When to it is added a perseverance that does not weaken before the different points have been assimilated one after another, a beautiful success is assured. Therefore, the advice of the hexagram is addressed to both the teacher and the student.
imagen: At the foot of the mountain a fountain emerges, an image of youth. Thus, the noble man cultivates his character scrupulously in all his actions. The fountain manages to flow and triumphs over stagnation, filling all the gaps in its path. In the same way, the path that must be followed for the development of character is thoroughness, and a seriousness that does not neglect anything, like water, which progressively and relentlessly fills all the gaps in its path, continuing its march forward.

juicio: The Wait. If you are sincere, you will have brilliance and success. Perseverance brings good fortune. It is advantageous to cross the big current. Waiting is not an empty hope. There is an inner certainty of reaching the goal. Only this inner certainty gives the clarity that leads to success. It leads to perseverance that brings fortune and confers the strength to cross great waters. Someone faces a danger that must be overcome. Weakness and impatience do not help. Only he who is strong can overcome destiny, because he can remain firm until the end thanks to his inner security. This force reveals itself as an inflexible truthfulness. Only when we have the courage to face things as they are, without any deception or illusion, do we have enough clarity to observe the entire line of events and recognize the path to success. This recognition must be followed by determined and persevering action, since it is only when one resolutely faces his destiny that he can master it. At that moment man will be prepared to cross the great waters, that is, he will be able to make the necessary decisions to overcome the danger.
imagen: The clouds climb in the sky: the image of waiting: The noble man eats and drinks. He is happy and comforted by good things. When clouds rise in the sky, they indicate an upcoming rain. The only thing you can do is wait for it to rain. It's the same in life when destiny is prepared. While the time has not yet come, it is useless to worry and try to shape the future by interfering with things with your own action and activity, but it is necessary to peacefully gather your strength by eating and drinking, as far as the body is concerned, and being in a good mood, as far as the mind is concerned. Destiny comes by itself and when we are ready.

juicio: The Conflict. You are sincere and you encounter obstacles. A prudent pause on the road brings fortune. Bringing the matter to a conclusion brings misfortune. It is advantageous to see the great man. It is not wise to cross great waters. Conflict arises when someone is convinced of their full right and faces opposition. If one is not convinced of one's own right, resistance gives rise to cunning or provokes violent excesses, but not conflict. When one is involved in a conflict, the only means of salvation lies in circumspection and the inner strength with which one is always ready to resolve the dispute and make a compromise by sharing the difference. Continuing a conflict to a painful outcome always has bad consequences, even when one is right, because this perpetuates the enmity. It is important to see the great man, that is, someone impartial whose authority is broad enough to fairly reach a peaceful solution to the conflict and decide justly. On the other hand, it is necessary, in times of trouble, not to “cross the great waters”; That is, avoid starting dangerous enterprises, the success of which requires the union of concerted forces. Conflict paralyzes strength and prevents overcoming external danger.
imagen: The sky and the water go in reverse: the image of Conflict. Thus the noble man considers from the beginning of all the matters he deals with. The image alludes to the fact that the causes of the conflict are latent in the opposing tendencies of both parties. Where such divergent provisions exist, conflict is inevitable. Consequently, to prevent such a conflict, one must necessarily consider everything from the beginning. If right and duty are exactly determined, or if the spiritual tendencies of a group of individuals are harmonized, the root cause of the conflict is ruled out in advance.

juicio: The army needs perseverance and a strong man. Fortune without reproaches. An army is a mass that needs organization to become a fighting force. Without strict discipline nothing can be achieved, but discipline should not be based on force. A strong man is required to win the hearts of the people and awaken their enthusiasm. To develop his abilities, this man requires the complete trust of the ruler who must transfer his responsibilities to him for the entire duration of the war. But a war is always a dangerous thing that brings harm and devastation. That is why it should not be considered lightly but rather used as a toxic drug, which should only be used as a last resort. The just cause and clear goal of a war must be explained to the people by an experienced leader. Only when there is a precise war objective for which the people can expose themselves in full consciousness are the unity and strength of conviction that lead to victory born. But the general must be careful that the passion of war and the delirium of victory do not lead to unjust acts that deserve general disapproval. If justice and perseverance are at the basis of action, everything will be fine.
imagen: In the middle of the earth is water: the image of the Army. The noble man increases his influence through generosity towards the People. When danger threatens, every countryman can become a soldier and, at the end of the war, return to his plow. He who is generous with his people wins their affection, and the people who live under a regime of moderation become strong and energetic. Only an economically powerful people can constitute a considerable war force. Therefore, we must cultivate power by favoring economic relationships between people and with a benevolent exercise of authority. Only if there is this invisible link between the government and the people, and the people are protected by such government, like the water in the depths of the earth, is it possible to lead a war to victory.

juicio: Solidarity brings good fortune. Ask the oracle again to know if you have the sublimity, constancy and perseverance. So there are no reproaches. The insecure ones are approaching little by little. He who arrives too late finds misfortune. It is about associating with others in order to complement each other and help each other through solidarity. Such a union requires a center around which one groups with the others. Becoming a center for the union of men is a serious matter and one of great responsibility. This requires inner greatness, being logical and strong. That is why he who wants to gather others around him must test himself to know if he is up to the task. Whoever wants to gather others without having the aptitude and the vocation, causes more confusion than if there were no meeting. But where there is a real meeting point, you see the insecure approaching, by themselves and little by little, in a hesitant way at first. Those who arrive too late will suffer for it. It is a union that must be carried out in a timely manner. Relationships are established and affirmed following certain internal laws. Common experiences consolidate them. Whoever arrives too late and cannot take part in those fundamental experiences, and when he finds the door closed, will have to reproach himself for his insecurity and lateness. If a man recognizes the need for regrouping and is not strong enough to place himself at the center of the union, his duty will then be to become another member of the community.
imagen: On earth there is water: the image of solidarity. The kings of ancient times divided states into fiefdoms and cultivated friendly relations with feudal lords. Water fills the empty spaces of the earth and adheres strongly to it. The social organization of antiquity was founded on this maxim of union between vassals and lords. Water brings together all its courses by itself because in all its parts it is subject to the same laws. Thus, human society must also observe the union thanks to a community of interests that makes different individuals feel like members of a whole. The central power of a social organism must ensure that each member finds his true interest in the union, as was the case in the paternal relations that the king of ancient China maintained with his vassals.

nombre: THE DOMINANT POWER OF THE SMALL
juicio: The domesticating power of the small succeeds. Dense clouds, but no rain for our western region. The situation is compared to that of China at the time of King Wen, who was originally from the West, but who was at that time in the East, at the court of the great sovereign, the tyrant Tcheu Sin. The time for large-scale action had not yet come, and Wen could only restrain the tyrant to a certain extent by friendly persuasion. Hence the image of abundant clouds that rise, promising the earth moisture and blessing, but that have not yet made it rain. The situation is not unfavorable and allows us to predict final success. However, there are still obstacles along the way. Approach work can begin. You can only act using the humble means of suggestions full of goodness. The time has not yet come for sweeping and energetic measures. However, it is possible to exert a moderating and softening influence within a limited radius. The realization of such a will requires firm resolution within and smooth adaptation without.
imagen: The wind exerts its thrust high in the sky. The image of the domesticating power of the small. The noble man refines the external form of his being. The wind can stir a group of clouds in the sky, but since it is just air without a solid body, it produces no significant or lasting effects. Therefore, at times when great external action is not possible, people can only refine the expressions of their being by doing small things.

juicio: Walking on the tail of a tiger. This one doesn't bite the man. Success. The situation is really difficult. The strongest and weakest are closely linked. The weak go after the strong and deal with them. But the strong accept it without getting upset because the contact is joyful and not hurtful. The human situation described is that of dealing with wild and inaccessible people. In this case the goal can be achieved if good manners are observed. Good manners and pleasant behavior lead to success even when dealing with irritable people.
imagen: The situation is really difficult. The strongest and weakest are closely linked. The weak go after the strong and deal with them. But the strong accept it without getting upset because the contact is joyful and not hurtful. The human situation described is that of dealing with wild and inaccessible people. In this case the goal can be achieved if good manners are observed. Good manners and pleasant behavior lead to success even when dealing with irritable people.

juicio: The small goes and the big comes. Fortune. Success. The hexagram indicates the presence in nature of a time where heaven is in a certain way above the earth. The sky located under the earth. Thus the two principles unite their virtues in an intimate harmony. From there comes peace and blessing for all beings. In the world of men it is a time of social harmony. The superiors lower themselves towards the inferiors, while the humble and the inferior nurture friendly feelings towards the superiors, so well that all hostility is appeased. Inside, in the center, in the decisive place is the light (2nd ruling line); The darkness is outside. Thus, the light principle exercises a creative influence and the dark principle maintains a submissive attitude. So both parties receive what is due and deserve. When the good occupy a predominant place in society and have power in their hands, the bad themselves come under the influence of the good and improve themselves. When, in man, the spirit that comes from heaven reigns, sensitivity is also under its influence and occupies its proper place. The different lines enter the hexagram from below and leave it at the top. They are the small, weak and bad elements that are preparing to leave, while the large, strong and good factors rise. This brings good fortune and success.
imagen: Heaven and earth united; the image of peace. The ruler divides and completes the course of heaven and earth; It provides and regulates the gifts of heaven and earth, thus helping people. Heaven and earth have a relationship with each other and unite their effects. This is a time of general prosperity. All this flow of energy must be regulated by an appropriate ruler, so that it is used as best as possible. This result is obtained thanks to the distribution. Thus undifferentiated time is divided by man into seasons, according to the succession of natural phenomena; The space that surrounds all things is divided into cardinal points by human work. Thus, nature and the overwhelming abundance of its phenomena must be restricted and limited. On the other hand, nature must be promoted in its production. This happens when the production is adapted to the convenient time and place. This increases natural performance. This activity of dominating and favoring production is a work on nature that returns the good to man.

juicio: The stagnation. Bad people do not favor the perseverance of the noble man. The big goes and the small comes. Heaven and earth no longer communicate with each other and all things stop. The high and the low no longer maintain mutual relations; confusion and disorder reign on Earth. Inside is darkness and light outside. Inside is weakness, and outside is hardness; Inside is the vulgar, and outside are the noble beings. The nature of the common people increases and that of the nobles decreases. But noble beings do not allow themselves to be dissuaded from their principles. However, if they no longer have the opportunity to act, they remain faithful to their principles and withdraw secretly.
imagen: Heaven and earth do not unite: image of stagnation. Thus, the noble man withdraws into his inner courage to escape difficulties. It does not allow you to be rewarded with income. When mutual distrust reigns in public life, as a consequence of the influence exerted by vulgar men, fruitful activity is impossible because the foundations are false. That is why the noble man knows what he has to do in such circumstances. He does not allow himself to be seduced by the brilliant proposals that invite him to participate in public affairs: it would be dangerous for him, because he cannot accept the meanness of others. That is why he hides his merit and retires secretly.

juicio: The community with men in broad daylight. Success. It is advantageous to cross the big current. Man's perseverance is advantageous. True community with men must be based on universal interests. It is not the selfish objectives of oneself, but the designs that concern humanity that form a lasting community with men. That is why success is predicted for a community with men in broad daylight. When harmony reigns, difficult undertakings such as crossing the great current can be carried out successfully. In any case, to create such a community, the presence of an enlightened leader with defined and enthusiastic convictions is required, who is willing to carry out the company. The lower trigram has the sense of clarity and the upper trigram the sense of creative force.
imagen: The sky united with fire: image of the community with men. Thus, the noble man makes the division into families and establishes distinctions between things. The sky moves in the same direction as the fire, and yet is distinct from it. Just as the luminous bodies in the sky serve to structure and divide time, so the human community and all the things that really belong to it must be organically structured. The community should not be a mixture of individuals or things - that would be chaos, not a community - but for order to be established, it requires a structured multiplicity.

juicio: Possession to a large extent. sublime success. The two trigrams indicate that strength and clarity come together. The possession of the great is determined by destiny and corresponds to the time. How can it be that the weak line has the power to hold together and possess the strong elements? For his will free of selfishness. The season is favorable. Inner strength, clarity and culture on the outside. Power is externalized with finesse and self-control. That brings sublime success and wealth.
imagen: Fire high in the sky. The image of the possession of the great. Thus the noble man represses evil, favors good and thus obeys the good will of heaven. The Sun, dominating the sky, illuminating all terrestrial things with its rays, is the image of the possession of greatness. But a possession of this nature must be managed correctly. The Sun brings the good and the bad to the light of day. Man must repress and combat evil and promote and favor good. Only in this way will he be in accordance with the good will of God, who wants only good and not evil.

juicio: Humility brings success. The noble man carries out his affairs successfully. The law of heaven empties what is full and fills what is humble: when the Sun is at its highest, by celestial law it must decline and when it is deep beneath the earth, it must head towards a new rise; When the Moon is full it begins to wane and when it is empty, it must begin to grow again. This heavenly law also acts in human destinies. The law of the land is to change all that is full and to flow into that which is humble. The high mountains are worn away by the waters and the valleys filled. The law of the powers of destiny is to diminish what is full and dispense happiness to the humble. Men also hate what is full and love humility. Destiny follows fixed laws that act in a necessary way. But man has the power to shape his destiny to the extent that his conduct exposes him to the influence of forces of blessing or destruction. When a man occupies a high position and is humble, he shines in the light of wisdom. When it is lowered and humble, it cannot be ignored. Thus, the noble man manages to carry out his work towards a good end without boasting about what he has accomplished.
imagen: In the center of the Earth there is a mountain: the image of humility. So the noble man reduces what is in excess and increases what is lacking. He weighs things and makes them equal. The Earth in which a mountain is hidden does not show its wealth, because the height of the mountain serves to balance the depressions. Therefore, high and low complement each other and the result is flatness. The image of humility shows here in the fact that it has required long work and that it seems natural and easy. The noble man does the same when he establishes order on the Earth. Equalizes social oppositions that are sources of conflict and, with this, creates fair and equitable relationships

juicio: The enthusiasm. It is favorable to enlist auxiliaries and set armies in motion. The time of enthusiasm comes with the presence of a notable man, who is in sympathy with and in agreement with the soul of the people. That is why he finds general obedience freely consented. To awaken enthusiasm it is necessary to agree the orders one gives with the nature of those governed. The rigidity of natural laws is based on the rule of movement that follows the line of least resistance. These laws are not external to things but rather they constitute the immanent harmony of movement. That is why the celestial bodies do not deviate from their orbits and all natural phenomena occur with a fixed regularity. The same thing happens in human society. Only laws that are rooted in popular sentiment are executed, while those that contradict it only arouse resentment.     Enthusiasm makes it possible to enlist auxiliaries to carry out the work without fearing secret oppositions. Enthusiasm is also what allows popular mass movements to be standardized, especially during wars, in order to obtain victory.
imagen: Thunder comes resounding from the earth: the image of enthusiasm. Thus, the ancient kings made music in honor of the merits, and presented them with magnificence before the supreme God, inviting their ancestors. At the beginning of summer, when thunder and electrical energy come resounding from the earth, the first storm refreshes nature and ends a long tension. Relief and joy are established. Likewise, music has the power to dispel the tension of the heart and the gloomy feelings of violence. The enthusiasm of the heart is spontaneously expressed in the sound of song, dance and rhythmic movement of the body. Since time immemorial, the invisible and stimulating effect of sound that unites and moves people's hearts has been perceived as an enigma. And the rulers knew how to take advantage of that natural taste for music. They enhanced it and organized it. Music was considered something serious and sacred that should serve to purify people's feelings; It was intended to praise the virtues of heroes and establish a link with the invisible world. In the temple people approached God accompanied by music and pantomimes (these later gave birth to theater). The religious sense towards the Creator of the world was united to the most sacred of human feelings, veneration for ancestors. These were invoked in religious ceremonies as guests of the Lord of heaven and representatives of humanity before the supreme. Thus linking one's own past with divinity in solemn moments of religious enthusiasm, the union between God and humanity was established. The ruler who venerated divinity in his ancestors was considered the Son of Heaven, in whom the celestial world entered into mystical contact with the terrestrial world. These thoughts are the ultimate and supreme summary of Chinese culture. Confucius himself said regarding the great sacrifice that was performed during these rites: “He who has completely understood this sacrifice will be able to rule the world as if he were spinning it in the palm of his hand.”

trigramas.superior: Tui, the lake; the happy, the pleasant
trigramas.inferior: Chen: the thunder; what awakens, the shock.

juicio: The succession achieves sublime success. Perseverance is advantageous. Without reproaches. To build an entourage one must first know how to adapt. It is only by serving that one comes to command, since in that only way can the satisfactory consent of those who follow be obtained. If one tries to get them to follow him by force or intrigue, by conspiracies or by creating factions, he will invariably encounter resistance and obstacles that prevent free adherence. We should not force others to follow us, but rather they should come spontaneously. But a happy move can also lead to annoying results. That is why “perseverance is advantageous” is added, that is, permanence in what is good and without reproach. Just as only under this condition can one acquire adhesion, it is only under this condition that one can follow others without harm. The idea of ​​creating an entourage adapting to the demands of the hour is great and important; That is why the judgment is so favorable.
imagen: The lake is in the middle of the thunder: image the succession. Thus, at dusk the wise man enters to recreate and rest. In the fall the electricity returns to the earth to rest. It corresponds to the thunder in the middle of the lake. It is not thunder in motion, but thunder in its winter rest. The entourage is shown in this image with the sense of an adaptation to the demands of the time. The thunder in the middle of the lake indicates the time of darkness and rest. Thus the wise man, after having expressed creative activity all day, grants himself recreation and rests when night comes. A situation can only be made good if one knows how to adapt and if one does not wear out in a displaced resistance.

juicio: Working on what is corrupt has sublime success. It is convenient to cross the great waters. Before the starting point, three days. After the starting point, three days. What is corrupted through the fault of men can be repaired with the work of men. It is not about an inexorable destiny, like the era of stagnation, but about the consequences of an abuse of human freedom that has caused such a state of corruption. Working to improve conditions favors success because it is in accordance with the possibilities of the time. We must not shrink from toil and danger - symbolized by the crossing of the great waters - but must confront them energetically. However, success has as a precondition a fair reflection on which the correct decision depends. That is the meaning of “before the starting point, three days. after the starting point, three days.” We must first know the causes of corruption before we can remedy it. Hence we must pay attention to what precedes the starting point. Furthermore, we must be careful to take the right path in order to avoid relapse, hence we must pay attention to what happens after the game. Resolution and energy must replace indifference and inertia for a new beginning to finally appear.
imagen: The wind blows at the foot of the mountain: image of Corruption. The noble man stirs up the people and strengthens their spirit. When the wind blows at the foot of the mountain, it forms whirlpools that ruin the crops. That calls for improvement. The same thing happens with low dispositions and poor quality fashions: they introduce corruption into human society. To banish corruption we must regenerate the nobility of society. The methods to do so are indicated with two primitive signs, but their effects must unfold in an orderly succession: first the state of stagnation must be removed, moving public opinion (like the wind that destroys everything), and then strengthening and calming the popular spirit (like the mountain nourishes and protects the plants that grow around it).

trigramas.inferior: Tui, the Lake, the happy, the pleasant

juicio: The approach is sublimely successful. Perseverance is advantageous. When the eighth month arrives there is misfortune. The hexagram as a whole indicates a time of hopeful progress. Spring is coming. Joy and good humor bring the highs closer to the lows. Success is assured. The favorable character of the time is sufficient. You must work with determination to take advantage of all the auspiciousness of the season. Another thing, spring won't last forever. In the eighth month things are reversed. There are only two strong lines that do not advance, but rather retreat. (See the following hexagram) We must remember this in time. If evil is prevented before the rains or if we anticipate danger before it appears, then we can master it.
imagen: Above the lake is the land, the image of the approach. The noble man is inexhaustible in his intention to teach and without limits to sustain and protect the people. The land borders the lake on top. It is the image of the approach and condescension of the superior man towards those who are at the bottom. The analogy of the hexagram with these two categories of beings comes from each of its parts. Just as the lake is inexhaustible in its depth, the wise man has an inexhaustible disposition to teach humanity; Just as the earth is boundlessly vast to sustain and care for all creatures, the wise man sustains and cherishes all people, without excluding with any limit any part of humanity.

juicio: Contemplation. The ablutions were done, but not yet the offerings. Full of confidence, they look towards him. The ritual of sacrifice in China began with an ablution and a libation that constituted an invocation to divinity. After that the sacrifice was offered. The time interval between these two rites was the most sacred, the moment of supreme inner recollection. When piety is inspired by faith, sincere contemplation of the spectacle on offer transforms witnesses and inspires respect in them. Thus, there is in nature a sacred and serious meaning in the regularity with which all natural events occur. The contemplation of this divine sense of the events of the universe places in the hands of him who is called to act on men the means of exerting the same effects. For this, an interior recollection similar to that produced by religious contemplation in men endowed with great and intense faith is necessary. Thus, they see the divine and mysterious laws of life and make them manifest in their own personality thanks to the extreme intensity of their meditation. As a consequence of this vision, a powerful spiritual power emanates from them that acts on men and subdues them without their being aware of how this occurs.
imagen: The wind blows over the earth: the image of contemplation. Thus the ancient kings visited the regions of the world, contemplated the people and taught. When the wind blows over the land it is present in all places and the grass must bend under its force. These two facts are confirmed in this hexagram. The two images symbolize the way of acting of the kings of antiquity: on the one hand, thanks to their regular trips they obtained a general view of their people in such a way that no custom in force could escape them. On the other hand, in this way they exerted their influence thanks to which inappropriate habits were modified. The set indicates the power of the higher personality. Such a man will have such a general view of the great multitude and its true dispositions that he will not be able to deceive himself. On the other hand, he will exert his influence on her by his simple presence, so that the crowd can regulate itself with him as the grass does with the wind.

juicio: Biting through is successful. It is favorable to let justice be exercised. When an obstacle opposes the meeting, forcefully separating it is the most appropriate. That is valid in all situations. Where unity cannot be achieved, it is always due to the impediment caused by a slanderer or a traitor who acts as an obstacle and brake. Then you have to bite vigorously to prevent lasting damage from growing. Such conscious obstacles do not disappear by themselves. Judgment and punishment are necessary to intimidate or separate them. But in such a company you have to proceed in the right way. The hexagram is made up of the union of Li, clarity, and Chen, excitement. Li is soft, Chen is hard. Harshness and irritation alone would be too violent in the administration of punishment. Clarity and softness, by themselves, would be too weak. Together, these two properties make the right measure. It is important that the man who is responsible for making the decision (represented here by the 5th line) is soft by nature while, thanks to his position, he exercises an action that inspires respect. (See character and position of the strokes)
imagen: Thunder and lightning. The image of biting through. Thus the old kings established firm laws with well-defined penalties. Punishments constitute the individual applications of the laws. Laws must contain mention of punishments (planned for those who violate them). Clarity reigns if, when setting penalties, minor and serious offenses are distinguished according to the nature of the transgressions. That is symbolized by clarity, by lightning. The firmness of the laws is achieved by the just application of penalties. This clarity and this severity are intended to keep men within respect; Punishments are not important in and of themselves. Obstacles become important in the collective life of men when penalties are not clearly determined and they are applied negligently. The only way to consolidate the laws is to make the punishments clear, fixed and quick.

juicio: Grace succeeds. In small matters it is favorable to undertake something. Grace brings success. However, it is not essential for fundamental matters, but rather an ornament that must be used sparingly in small things. In the lower trigram, fire, a weak line gets between two strong lines and makes them beautiful; but the strong lines are the essence, the weak line is the form that embellishes. In the upper trigram, the mountain, the strong line appears at the summit, in a determining place, in such a way that here it must still be considered as the decisive factor. In nature the sun occupies a strong position and the life of the world depends on it. But the strong position of the sun is surrounded by the moon and the stars that alternate gracefully with it. In human life, beauty of form appears when strong, mountain-like characters are made pleasing by clear beauty. By contemplating what happens in the sky we come to understand the times and the changing demands. The contemplation of forms in human life confers the possibility of shaping the world. Note: The hexagram shows beauty at rest. Inside clarity and outside stillness. It is the stillness of pure contemplation. When desire is silent and the will rests, the universe is revealed as Idea in appearances. As such, it is beautiful and removes the struggle for existence. It is the world of art. But, ultimately, contemplation for its own sake does not put the will at rest. It will awaken and all the beauty will have been only a moment of passing exaltation. That is why beauty and grace are not true paths of liberation. Consequently, Confucius felt very upset when, consulting the oracle, he received “grace” as the answer.
imagen: Under the mountain there is fire. The image of grace. Thus the noble man progresses when he clarifies ordinary matters but it is not in this way that he will be able to decide important questions. The fire, whose light illuminates the mountains and makes them pleasant, does not shine far away. In the same way, beautiful forms are enough to illuminate the most immediate questions but not to decide the important questions. These require greater seriousness.

juicio: The dispersion. It is not convenient to start something or go anywhere. It shows a time when weak and inferior people are advancing and are on their way to surpassing the last strong and noble. This situation is a cause of the course of time. Under these circumstances, it is not favorable for the noble man to undertake any business. Correct conduct in these adverse times must be deduced from the image and its attributes. The lower trigram represents the earth whose attributes are docility and devotion; The upper trigram represents the mountain whose attribute is peace. This suggests putting up with bad weather and staying calm. It is not about what man does, but about the conditions of the time that, according to the laws of heaven, show alternatives of progress and decay, plenitude and emptiness. These temporary conditions do not allow any reaction and it is impossible to counteract them. It is not cowardice but wisdom to know how to adapt and refrain from acting.
imagen: The mountain rests on the earth: The image of dispersion. Those above can only secure their position by making generous concessions to those below. The mountain rests on the earth. If it is narrow, steep and lacking a wide base, it must collapse. It is only if she knows how to rise wide and vast from the earth, and not proud and abrupt, that her position is assured. The rulers rest on the long base of the people. They must also show generosity and greatness of soul, just like the earth that sustains all beings. Only in this way will they maintain their position as safe and calm as a mountain.

juicio: Return. Success. Leaving and returning without error. Friends come without reproaches. The road comes and goes. On the seventh day he returns. It is advantageous to have somewhere to go. After a period of decline, the return begins. The power of light, which had been removed, is found again. There is movement, but it is not something imposed: the upper trigram, K'un, has the character of abandonment and giving of oneself. It is then a natural act that is born spontaneously. That is why the transformation of old things becomes very easy. The old is deposed, the new is introduced, both are in conformity with time and do not cause any harm. Groups of like-minded beings are formed. But these meetings are held openly, since they correspond to the time and therefore all selfish efforts are excluded and there is no fault in them. The return is founded on nature. The movement is circular. The road closes on itself. That is why nothing should be rushed artificially. Everything comes spontaneously when the time has come. Such is the meaning of heaven and earth. All movements are carried out in six stages, and the seventh results in the return. Thus, in the seventh month after the summer solstice, where the year begins to decline, comes the winter solstice. In the same way that sunrise comes at the seventh double hour that follows sunset. That is why seven is the number of the young light that is born when six, the number of darkness, increases by one unit. With that the movement stops.
imagen: Thunder over the earth. The image of the return point. Thus, the kings of ancient times closed the passages at the time of the solstice. Merchants and foreigners did not circulate and the ruler did not travel through the provinces. The winter solstice has always been celebrated in China as the time of rest of the year, a custom that is celebrated with the time of rest observed on the occasion of the new year. In winter, the vital power (symbolized by what awakens, thunder) is still underground. The movements are only in their first beginnings. That is why you must still fortify yourself with rest, in order not to waste it by making premature use of it. This maxim, which prescribes allowing the energy that is renewed to be strengthened by rest, applies to all analogous situations. The health that returns after an illness, the understanding that is reborn after a dispute, everything must be treated, at the beginning, with delicacy and comfort so that the return leads to prosperity.

juicio: Innocence. Supreme success. Perseverance is advantageous. If someone is not what they should be, they will have bad fortune and that will not help them undertake anything. Man received from heaven an originally good nature to guide him in his movements. By adhering to this divine principle in him, man attains a pure innocence which, without dwelling on thoughts of reward and interest, does what is right, simply and with instinctive assurance. It is this instinctive security that brings him supreme success and that favors him through perseverance. However, everything that is instinctive is not natural in the proper sense of the word, but only that which is just and in accordance with the will of heaven. If there is a lack of justice, irrational instinctive activity produces only misfortunes. Confucius says in this regard, "What does he gain who departs from innocence? The will and blessing of heaven do not accompany his actions.
imagen: Thunder circulates under the sky. All things come to the natural state of innocence. The ancient kings, rich in virtues and in harmony with time, cared for and nourished all beings. In the spring, when thunder, the life force, moves again under the sky, all things germinate and grow, and all beings receive from creative nature the childlike innocence of the original essence. This is also how good rulers, who show the internal richness of their nature, act among men, caring for all life and civilization, and in due time, do everything that they require for their maintenance and progress.

nombre: THE DOMINANT POWER OF THE GREAT
juicio: The dominant power of the great. Perseverance is advantageous. Not eating at home brings good fortune. It is advantageous to cross the big current. To firmly capture and treasure the creative powers requires a strong man of clear understanding who can be honored by the sovereign. The Ch'ien trigram indicates great creative power, while the Ken trigram indicates firmness and truth. Both translate light, clarity and the daily renewal of character. Only through daily renewal can man increase his powers. The force of habit helps to maintain order in quiet times, but in times where accumulated power is used, everything depends on the force of personality. Since men of merit are honest, as proven by the strong personality to whom the sovereign entrusts governmental responsibilities, it is advantageous not to eat at home, but to earn one's bread in a public occupation by holding an official position. Such a man is in harmony with heaven and will triumph even if he undertakes difficult and dangerous undertakings such as crossing the great current.
imagen: Heaven in the middle of the mountain. The image of the dominant power of the great. The noble man informs himself about many ancient sayings and past experiences, to strengthen his character with them. The sky in the middle of the mountain evokes hidden treasures. The words and actions of the past contain a hidden treasure that can be used to strengthen and educate character. This is the correct way to study, which is not limited to knowing history, but rather making history a current reality using its data.

juicio: The corners of the lips. Perseverance brings fortune. Observe the administration of food and what man seeks to fill his own mouth. When you are concerned about protection and nutrition, it is important to take care of the right people, and make sure that you are nourished in the right way. If one wants to know the nature of a person, it is enough to observe who they care for and what parts of themselves their nature cultivates and nourishes. Nature nourishes all creatures. The noble man cultivates his noble parts, sometimes to the detriment of his vilest parts. The noble man nurtures and protects people of value in order to protect all others through them. Mencius says about it (VI, A, 14): "When one wants to know the value of someone, one must observe what part of himself he considers particularly important. The body has noble parts and vile parts; there are parts more important than others. One should not cause harm to what is important to the detriment of what is secondary, nor to what is noble for the love of what is vile. He who cultivates the vile parts of his being is a vile man. He who cultivates the noble parts of his being He is a noble man.
imagen: At the foot of the mountain, thunder. The image of food administration. The noble man is careful with his words and measured in eating and drinking. God appears in the trigram of excitement", when in the spring the vital powers begin to move again, all beings are born again; and "he is realized in the trigram of the immobile." Thus, at the beginning of spring, when the seeds fall to the ground, all things prepare for a new cycle of life. This provides a model of the administration of nutrition through movement and the immobile. The wise man sees there a model to follow in nutrition and in the culture of his character. Words constitute a movement from the inside to the outside. Food and drink constitute movements from the outside to the inside. Both kinds of movement can be tempered by moderation: words leave the mouth without exceeding their proper measure and food enters in the same way. This is how character is cultivated.

trigramas.inferior: Sun. The Soft, the Wind, the Forest

juicio: The big overweight. The ridge beam tilts by itself. It is advantageous to have somewhere to go. Success. The important thing is being overweight. The load is too heavy for the force that must support it. The ridge beam, on which the entire roof rests, folds in on itself and threatens to give way because its extremities are too weak for the weight they must support. The roof is about to break. This is an exceptional time and situation that requires extraordinary measures if you want to succeed. It is necessary to find a transition path as quickly as possible and take action. This promises success, since although the strong is excessive, it occupies the center and is inside, so a revolution should not be feared. Nothing will be obtained with forced and violent measures. You have to proceed gently, untying the knots and penetrating the meaning of the situation, which is evoked by the lower trigram Sun. Then the transition to other conditions will be successful. This requires real superiority, which is why the time when overweight predominates is an important time.
imagen: The lake grows above the trees. The image of the great overweight. The noble man does not worry when he is alone nor does he allow himself to be discouraged if he must renounce the world. The exceptional times of being overweight are similar to a flood where the lake rises over the trees. But such situations are temporary. Each of the trigrams indicates the conduct to follow in such moments: the image of Sun is the tree that resists even when isolated, and the attribute of Tui is the joyful serenity that remains undaunted, even though it must renounce the world.

juicio: The unfathomable repeated. If you are sincere, you will achieve what you heartily want and you will achieve success in whatever you do. Through repetition of danger, one becomes accustomed to it. Water sets the example of appropriate behavior in these circumstances. It comes and goes, filling all the spaces where it passes. She does not retreat from any danger or any fall, nothing modifies her but she remains faithful to her essential nature. This is how sincerity acts in difficult circumstances, so that, in the intimacy of the heart, the meaning of the situation is penetrated. And as soon as one has internally mastered the situation, external actions naturally follow that will be crowned with success. What counts in the face of danger is the moral depth with which everything that must actually be done is carried out, and to move forward so as not to succumb to the danger for having delayed. Used actively, danger can be of great importance as a protective measure. The sky has its dangerous height that protects it against invasion attempts, and the earth has the waters and mountains that separate the countries with their dangers. Rulers also use danger to protect themselves against external attacks and internal turmoil.
imagen: The waters flow uninterruptedly and reach their goal: the image of the abysmal repeated. The noble man walks through virtue and exercises the function of teaching. The water reaches its goal by flowing without interruption. Fill each cavity before continuing its course. The noble man follows the example of water. He appreciates that the good becomes a permanent and solid property of his character, and not just something that depends on chance or the moment. When instructing others, everything equally depends on the spirit of continuity, since it is only through repetition that teaching becomes the property of the student.

juicio: What adheres. Perseverance is advantageous. She brings success. Taking care of the cow brings good fortune. Darkness is subject to that which is luminous and thus perfects clarity. A luminous body that spreads clarity needs to have something that lasts inside to avoid being consumed entirely and to shine in a lasting way. Everything that is bright in the world depends on an element to which it adheres in order to shine permanently. The Sun and the Moon are subject to the sky, the grains, the grass and the trees are subject to the Earth. In the same way, the redoubled clarity of the chosen man adheres to what is right and can thus shape the world. When man, who is present in the world in a conditioned and non-autonomous situation, recognizes this dependence, he submits to the good and harmonious powers of the universe and achieves success. The cow is the symbol of extreme docility. By cultivating in him this docility and this voluntary dependence, man achieves clarity without excessive liveliness and finds his place in the world.
imagen: That which shines rises twice: the image of fire. The great man illuminates the four regions of the world, perpetuating this clarity. Each of the trigrams represents the Sun in the course of the day. Both represent the repeated movement of the Sun, the function of light with respect to time. The noble man continues the work of nature in the world of men. Through the clarity of his being, he causes the light to spread more and more and penetrate deeper into the nature of man.

juicio: Influence. Success. Perseverance is advantageous. Taking a maiden as a wife brings good fortune. The weak element is above, the strong element below. They mutually attract their forces until they unite. That brings victory. Indeed, all triumph is based on the effect of mutual attraction. The inner tranquility that accompanies external joy means that satisfaction is not excessive but remains within fair limits. Such is the meaning of the added indication: “perseverance is advantageous”, since there is the difference between the courtship made for the purpose of a marriage, where the strong man places himself with consideration under the weak woman, which differs from seduction. In this attraction, which is carried out according to elective affinities, it constitutes a general law of nature. Heaven and earth attract each other and thus all beings come into existence. The wise man acts on the hearts of men by means of an analogous attraction and peace is established in the universe. The nature of all things in heaven and earth can be known according to the attractions they exert.
imagen: On the mountain there is a lake: the image of influence. Thus, the noble man with his receptive disposition allows men to approach him. A mountain on which there is a lake obtains from it a stimulus that comes from its humidity and has this advantage from the fact that its summit is not a projecting peak but a cavity. The image advises being internally willing and free, remaining receptive to good advice. People quickly stop advising those who claim to know everything.

juicio: Success. Without remorse. Perseverance is advantageous. It is advantageous to have somewhere to go. Duration is a state whose movement is not impeded by obstacles. This is not a state of rest, because mere stopping is regression. Duration is rather a movement that is fulfilled following certain laws, coherent with itself and also constantly renewed; It indicates a framed and organized movement, firmly centered on itself, in which every end is constantly followed by a new beginning. The end is reached by a movement inward, inhalation of breath, systole, concentration. That movement is changed by a new beginning directed outwards: it is the exhalation of the breath, diastole, expansion. It is in this way that celestial bodies move through the sky in their orbits and can, therefore, shine in a lasting way. The seasons of the year develop following a fixed law of change and transformation, and can consequently act durably. Thus, the man who has heard the call gives lasting meaning to his way of life and the world is given shape. With this things acquire their duration, and it is possible to recognize the nature of all beings in heaven and on earth.
imagen: Thunder and wind: The image of duration. The noble man remains firm and does not change direction. Something lasting can only be achieved gradually through long work and careful reflection. Lao Tzu says in this sense: “If you want to compress something, you must first allow it to expand properly.” He who demands too much in the first attempt acts hastily and because he wants to have too much, in the end he will not obtain anything.

juicio: The conditions are such that they favor the hostile forces in their advance, favored by the times. In this case, withdrawal is the correct path and thus success is achieved. This withdrawal should not be confused with flight, in which one tries to save oneself at any cost. One must be careful not to miss the right moment while one remains in possession of one's strength and position. Then we will be able to interpret the signs of the times before it is too late to prepare that provisional retreat instead of engaging in a desperate combat between life and death. But it is not simply a matter of a desperate flight abandoning the battlefield to the adversary, but of making his advance more difficult by still resisting at isolated points. In this way, in the retreat one already prepares the counter-offensive. It is not easy to understand the laws of an active withdrawal. The meaning contained in such an action is important.
imagen: The mountain rises towards the sky, but it is in its nature that it ends up rising in the end. On the contrary, the sky retreats upwards before it so that it remains unreachable. It is the image of the way the noble man should behave in relation to the vulgar man who rises. He withdraws into himself, always surpassing the inferior. He does not hate it, because hate is a kind of participation by which one binds oneself to the hated object. With dignity, the noble man shows his strength (the sky) forcing the vulgar man to remain motionless (the mountain).

juicio: The power of what is great. Perseverance is advantageous. The hexagram indicates a time when inner courage increases vigorously and comes to power. But the force has already surpassed the midline. Therefore, there is a danger that one will trust too much in one's own strength without asking at every moment where the good is, and that one will want to get moving without waiting for the right moment. That is why the phrase that perseverance is advantageous is added. Because the truly great force is precisely that which does not degenerate into pure violence, but rather remains internally linked to the principles of justice and law. If one understands that greatness and justice must be inseparably linked, one also understands the true meaning of everything that happens in heaven and on earth.
imagen: The thunder is up in the sky. The image of the power of greatness. Thus, the noble man does not walk along paths that are not in accordance with order. Thunder, electrical energy, has an upward movement in the spring. This movement is in harmony with heaven. It is then a movement in harmony with the movement of the sky that produces the power of the great. But true greatness lies in conformity to what is right. That is why in times of great power the noble man avoids doing everything that is not in harmony with order.

juicio: As an example, a time is represented in which a powerful feudal lord gathers, in obedience and peace, the rest of the princes around the sovereign; The sovereign then offers him rich gifts and attracts him to his immediate surroundings.  The idea is twofold. The real effect of progress is based on a powerful man placed in a subordinate position, whom others regard as a fellow man, and consequently willingly follow him. This guide has enough internal clarity not to abuse the great influence he exerts and rather to use it for the benefit of the teacher (the sovereign). The latter, for his part, is free from all envy, and constantly attracts the great man to his court and offers him rich gifts. A teacher and an obedient servant are the conditions of great progress.
imagen: The Sun rises over the earth. The image of Progress. The noble man makes his own luminous dispositions shine for himself. The light from the Sun rising above the Earth is naturally bright. The higher the Sun rises, the more it separates itself from the turbid mists, radiating its original purity more widely. Thus, the true essence of man is good in its origin, but it is clouded by the terrestrial element, and consequently, requires purification in order to shine with its primitive clarity.

juicio: The darkening of the light. It is advisable to persevere in adversity. In unfavorable circumstances, one should not let oneself go without resistance or be helpless, allowing one's inner will to bend. But that is only possible when one is brilliant on the inside and flexible and docile on the outside. Even the most difficult adversity is overcome with that attitude. It is true that in some cases, one must hide his light in order to maintain his own will despite the difficulties born from the immediate environment. Perseverance must live in the most intimate part of consciousness and not manifest itself externally. Only in this way can the will be kept intact in the midst of difficulties.
imagen: The light has sunk into the earth: the image of the “darkening of the light.” Then the noble man lives with the great crowd hiding his appearance and remaining bright. In times of darkness, it is important to be careful and reserved. It is not through reckless conduct that one should uselessly attract invincible enmities. While people's habits should not be shared, it is also not appropriate to put them in the light of criticism. In such circumstances, one should not want to know everything. Things should be left alone without being deceived by them.

juicio: The family is founded on the relationships between husband and wife. The bond that maintains the unity of the family is the fidelity and perseverance of the woman. Her place is inside (2nd stroke) and that of the man is outside (5th stroke). Man and woman must conform to the great laws of nature, occupying their rightful place. The family needs to have firm authority, that of the parents. When the father is truly a father and the son is truly a son, when the older brother takes his place as the older brother and the younger takes the place of the younger, the husband is truly a husband and the wife is truly a wife, then order reigns in the family. When the family is in order, all the social relations of humanity are ordered. Three of the five social relationships take place within the family: father and son - relationship of love -, between husband and wife - relationship of respect - and between the older and younger brother - relationship of order. The love that unites father and son is socially translated by fidelity to duty. The affection and order that reign among brothers are applied to friendship under the aspect of loyalty and the attitude towards superiors under the form of deference. The respectful relationship between spouses translates as solidarity that serves as social cohesion. The family is the initial cell of society, the ground where the exercise of moral duties is sustained. The family is a narrow circle where the bases from which all human relationships in general will be created are found in an embryonic state.
imagen: Heat is transformed into strength, such is the meaning of the wind that comes out of the fire in the shape of a flame. It is the influence that acts from the inside to the outside. The same attitude is necessary in family governance. Here the influence also emanates from the personality to be exerted on others. For such an action to be possible, it is necessary that the words have force, but this is only the case if they are supported by something real, like the flame comes out of burning matter. Words only have influence when they are relevant and clearly relate to a given situation. Speeches and warnings generally have no effect. Furthermore, words must be sustained by the entire behavior, in the same way that the wind acts effectively when it is durable. Only firm and consistent activity will make an impression on others, because they will be able to accommodate and regulate themselves accordingly. If words and attitudes are not consistent and consistent with each other, they will have no influence or effect.

juicio: Opposition. In small matters, fortune. When men live in opposition and distant from each other, it is not possible to do much work together. The positions of each one differ too much from each other. Above all, it is important not to proceed directly and abruptly, because that would aggravate the contrast, but rather one should limit oneself to gradual actions related to small things. Here one can still hope for fortune, because the situation is such that the opposition does not exclude all understanding. Opposition, which generally appears as an obstruction, has a polarity of opposites within the encompassing set, and its function can be good and important. The oppositions between heaven and earth, spirit and nature, man and woman balance the creation and flowering of life. In the world of visible things, opposition makes possible differentiation into species through which order is established in the world.
imagen: Above the fire, below the lake: the image of the opposition. Therefore, the noble man preserves his particularity in every community. The two elements fire and water, even when they are together, do not mix but retain their own nature. The educated man, through the traffic of relationships and interests with other people, will never be able to unite with them but will preserve his own peculiarity in each community.

juicio: The obstacle. The southwest is advantageous. The northeast is not advantageous. It is advantageous to see the great man. Perseverance brings good fortune. The southwest is the region of retreat, the northeast that of advance. One finds oneself confronted with obstacles that cannot be overcome directly. In such a situation it is wise to pause in the face of danger, back up and wait. This is a preparation to overcome obstructions. One must join forces with those of friends and place oneself under the command of someone capable of facing the situation. Then you will succeed and the obstacles will be removed. This requires the desire to persevere even if one appears to move away from the goal. Clear and determined purpose ultimately brings good fortune. The obstacle that is only temporary is useful to one's own personal development. Therein lies the value of adversity.
imagen: Water over the mountain. The image of the obstacle. The noble man addresses himself and develops his character. Difficulties and obstacles repel man on himself. But while the vulgar man tries to put the blame on other people, lamenting his fate, the noble man looks for error in himself, and through this introspection the external obstacle is transformed into a means for his own enrichment and inner development.

juicio: The liberation. The southwest is advantageous. When there is nowhere left to go, return brings salvation. If there is still somewhere to go, hurrying brings fortune. It refers to a time when tensions and complications begin to dissipate. At such times, one should return to normal conditions as soon as possible, such is the meaning of the southwest. These are times of very important changes. Just as the liberating rain clears the atmospheric tension, and gives birth to all the buds, the moment in which one is freed from an oppressive burden, exerts a liberating and stimulating effect on life. However, it is important one does not exceed the limits of one's own triumph. It is necessary not to penetrate more than necessary. As soon as liberation is obtained, returning to the order of life is a salvation. If there are some pending issues to resolve, it must be done as soon as possible, to clear the situation and prevent any delay.
imagen: The thunder and rain dissipate: the image of liberation. The noble man forgives mistakes and absolves guilt. The storm has a purifying effect on the air; The noble man does the same when he sweeps away the errors and sins of people that cause states of tension. Brings liberation through clarity. However, when light is shed on defects, one should not insist on them, but simply correct errors and involuntary transgressions, just as thunder fades, sin is absolved, just as water cleanses everything of dirt.

juicio: Decrease accompanied by sincerity brings fortune without reproach. You can persevere in it. It is advantageous to undertake something. What can be done? Two small bowls can be used for sacrifice. Decrease doesn't always mean something bad. Growth and decline come in due time. What matters is understanding the times and not hiding poverty with false appearances. If the time of scarcity of resources brings us one's own truth, one need not be ashamed of its simplicity. It is precisely the correct disposition that gives the inner strength to undertake something new. One need not entertain bitter thoughts if the outward splendor of civilization and even the realization of religious forms must suffer from simplicity. One must borrow from the strength of inner feeling what is needed to compensate for the lack of external appearance. The firmness of the behavior helps to overcome what the simplicity of the form may have as excessive. Before God, a false brilliance is useless. Also with few humble means the dispositions of the heart can be expressed
imagen: At the foot of the mountain, there is the lake: the image of dwindling. The noble man controls his anger and dominates his instincts. The lake at the foot of the mountain evaporates. In this sense, the decrease benefits the mountains, which are enriched by their humidity. The mountain is the image of a stubborn force that can be condensed with anger. The lake is the image of uncontrolled joy, which can turn into passionate impulses when it develops at the expense of vital forces. It is important then to reduce: anger must be attenuated thanks to stopping, and instincts, stopped by limitations. Thanks to this waning of the lower powers of the soul, its higher attributes are enriched.

juicio: The increase. It is advantageous to undertake something. It is advantageous to cross the great waters. With the sacrifice that is made from above to increase what is below, an atmosphere of joy and gratitude is created in the people that is extremely valuable for the flourishing of the community. When men are thus attached to their leaders, something can be done; even difficult and dangerous matters will succeed. That is why, in such times of ascension, the development of which is accompanied by success, it is important to work and use the moment. This time resembles the mating between heaven and earth, when the earth participates with the creative power of heaven by shaping and realizing living beings. The time of increase does not last, that is why you should take advantage of it while it is here.
imagen: Wind and thunder, the image of the increase. The noble man if he sees the good, he imitates it; If there are defects, it gets rid of them. By observing how the wind and thunder amplify and strengthen each other, man can discover the path to perfect himself and develop personally. If one discovers something good in others, one must imitate it and thus appropriate everything good on earth. If one perceives something bad in oneself, one must get rid of it. Thus one is freed from evil. This ethical change is the most important increase in personality.

juicio: The irruption Resolutely one must make the matter known in the king's court. The truth must be proclaimed. Danger. You need to notify your own city. It is not appropriate to resort to weapons. It is advantageous to undertake something. Sometimes in a city, only a vulgar man who has a dominant position can subjugate the noble men. If the heart harbors only one passion, it can obscure reason. Passion and reason do not exist on their own, but rather fight relentlessly so that good prevails in the ruling class. In a determined fight of good against evil there are absolute rules that cannot be ignored if one wants to succeed. The resolution must be based on a union of strength and friendship. A compromise with evil is not possible. Evil must always be openly rejected, under any circumstances. Neither one's own passions nor defects should be allowed. The battle must not be conducted with violence. Wherever evil is detected, if one considers resorting to weapons and if one takes pleasure in resorting to force, responding to a blow with another blow, one is at a loss involved in a game of hatred and passion.
