That is why it is important to start by settling your own affairs and take care of your own defects that you have discovered in yourself. Thus, by not finding adversaries, the force of evil counteracts itself. Even our own defects should not be fought directly: as long as we fight against them, they will be victorious. The best way to combat evil is an energetic progress of good.
imagen: The lake rose into the sky, an image of the irruption. Thus, noble wealth is dispensed downward, fearing to stop at its virtue. When the lake water rises towards the sky, you can fear a cloud shower. The noble man takes this as a warning to prevent a violent collapse in time. Whoever wants to accumulate wealth only for himself and without thinking about others will experience bankruptcy. Every accumulation is in fact followed by a dispersion. That is why the noble man already begins to spread during the time he accumulates. Just as when cultivating his character, he is careful not to stop obstinately, but rather remains receptive to impressions through constant and rigorous examination of himself.

juicio: Coming to the appointment. The girl is powerful. One should not marry that girl. The ascension of the vulgar man (the growth of an inferior element) is painted by the image of an attractive girl who gives herself easily and thus takes command. This would not be possible if, for its part, the strong and luminous principle had not also come to meet him. The vulgar man seems so harmless and so docile that one makes a friend of him. It seems so small and so weak that one thinks of having fun with it without worry. The inferior man only rises because the noble man does not see him as dangerous and gives him power. If he resisted him from the beginning he would never be successful enough to gain influence. But the time that one comes to the encounter has another aspect that deserves to be examined. If the rule should not be that the weak come to the strong, this attitude, however, at certain moments assumes considerable significance. If heaven and earth meet, all creatures prosper. When the prince and his minister meet, order is established in the world. It is essential that the principles intended to relate to each other be mutually linked. This step alone should be free of ulterior motives, otherwise it would be bad.
imagen: Under the sky is the wind: The image of the action of coming to meet. This is how the prince acts when he publishes his orders and has them proclaimed by the four cardinal points. The situation is analogous to that of hexagram No. 20 Kuan “contemplation.” There the wind blows over the earth and here the wind blows under the sky. The wind is present in both cases. But there the wind was on the land; then it was a low wind, which took knowledge of the conditions of the kingdom. Here the wind blows high, indicating the influence that the sovereign exerts with his orders. The sky is far from the things that are on the earth, but it moves them with the wind. The sovereign is distant from the people, but he moves them with his orders and the expression of his will.

juicio: The meeting. success. The king approaches the temple. It is advantageous to see the great man. That brings success. Perseverance is advantageous. Making great sacrifices brings good fortune. It is beneficial to undertake something. The gathering of men in communities of certain importance is natural as within a family or artificial as in a state. The perpetuation of these meetings is accomplished through the cult of ancestors, on the occasion of which the entire clan gathers. Through collective devotion, the ancestors integrate into the spiritual life of their descendants, allowing the community not to disintegrate or dissolve. When men must be gathered together, religious power is necessary but not sufficient. An authority or human boss must also be present as the center of the meeting. In order to unite others, that meeting center must previously agree morally with itself. Through meditation, moral strength increases and allows people to come together. In these great periods of unification they bear fruit in great works. That is the meaning of making great sacrifices or offerings. In the public and profane domain, great works are also carried out on the basis of a meeting around a collective agreement.
imagen: Above the earth, there is the lake: the image of the gathering. The noble man renews his weapons preventing encountering the unforeseen. If the lake water accumulates and grows on the land, there is a danger of it overflowing. (2) Precautions must be taken to avoid this. Similarly, when men gather in large numbers conflicts can arise. Thieves lurk where goods accumulate. That is why during the harvest and harvest seasons we must guard against the unexpected by renewing our defenses and weapons. Human ills and suffering often come from unexpected events for which one was not prepared. If you are prepared you can prevent them.

juicio: The upward push has sublime success. You must see the great man. Don't be afraid! Going south brings fortune. The upward push of valuable elements does not encounter any obstacles, that is why it is accompanied by great success. The attitude that makes the upward push possible is not violent, but humble and docile. But as one is led by the favorable dispositions of the time, progress is made. We must move forward and look for the people who hold back authority. There is no need to be afraid to do it, since success is assured. You just have to get to work, since activity (this is signified by the south) is a source of fortune.
imagen: In the middle of the earth the forest grows: image of the upward push. Thus the noble man abandons himself to nature, accumulates small things to do great and lofty things. The forest on earth grows without haste and without rushing upward, docilely circumventing obstacles. The noble man and true to his character never rests in his progress.

juicio: Burden. Success. Perseverance. The great man works fortune. Without reproaches. When someone has something to say it is not believed. Times of adversity are the reverse of times of success. But they can lead to success if you find the right man. When a strong man is helpless he remains calm and alert despite all dangers, and this caution is the source of his later success. His firmness is stronger than destiny. He who lets his spirit be broken by despondency will not succeed. To whom adversity only breaks down and in which the strength to react is generated, in time that person will surely find the light. Vulgar men are not capable of this. Only the noble man brings good fortune with him and remains blameless. It is true that at the moment his influence is not recognized and that his words have no effect. That is why in times of adversity it is important to remain internally strong and sober in words.
imagen: There is no water in the lake: the image of exhaustion. The noble man risks his life to fulfill his purposes. When the water has been evacuated from beneath the lake, it must be depleted and dried. Such is destiny. It is the image of adverse destiny in human life. In such times, one cannot do anything other than accept one's destiny and remain true to oneself. It refers here to the deepest layer of the true essence of being, because it alone is superior to all external destiny.

trigramas.inferior: Sun The soft, the wind, the forest

juicio: The well. We can change the city, but we can't change the well. It does not decrease or increase. They come and go drawing water from the well. You have almost reached the water, but if the rope does not descend completely or if the pitcher breaks, that brings misfortune. In ancient China capitals were sometimes transferred, either because a new location seemed more favorable or because the dynasty had changed. The style of the buildings has changed over the centuries but the shape of the well remains the same from ancient times to the present day. The well is thus an image of the social organization of humanity in its most primitive vital needs; This organization is independent of all political forms. Political forms and nations change, but the lives of men with their demands always remain the same. She doesn't let herself be modified. This life is also inexhaustible. It neither decreases nor increases, and exists for everyone. Generations come and go, and everyone enjoys life in its inexhaustible abundance. In any case, a good political and social organization requires a double condition. One must descend to the foundations of life itself. Any superficial attitude in establishing the rules of life, leaving vital needs unsatisfied, is so imperfect that the absence of any attempt at reform. Equally bad is the negligence that causes the pitcher to break. If, for example, the military defense of a State is carried to such excess that it provokes war and thus leads to the destruction of the State, that is equivalent to the jug breaking. The hexagram applies in the same way to individuals. The different dispositions and different education among men induce a diversity among peoples. But deep down human nature is always the same as all men. Man can, in the course of his formation, draw from the inexhaustible source of divine nature that is the essence of man. But there two dangers threaten him: the first is that man does not penetrate, in the course of his formation, to the true roots of humanity, but rather remains a prisoner of conventions (such formation is as bad as the absence of formation) and the second, that he suddenly sinks, abandoning the formation of his being.
imagen: Water over the forest: the image of the well. The noble man encourages people in their work and exhorts them to help each other. Below is the trigram Sun, the forest; above, the K'an trigram, water. The forest draws water upwards. Just as the forest, as an organism, imitates the action of the well and seeks the good of all parts of the plant, so the noble man orders human society in such a way that, as in the plant organism, its members cooperate for the good of all.

juicio: Revolution. On your own day you are believed. Perseverance favors the greatest success. The regrets dissipate. Political revolutions are extremely serious matters. They should only be undertaken in cases of extreme necessity and only when there is no other way out. Not everyone is called to such action, but only those who enjoy the trust of the people and will not undertake it until the time is right. In such a matter, it is necessary to proceed correctly so that it can please the people and clarify it, avoiding excesses. Furthermore, one must remain free of all selfish intentions and truly care about the needs of the people. It is only in those conditions that there is no room for regrets. Times change and consequently demands become different. Just as the seasons change during the course of the year, there is also a spring and an autumn in the peoples and nations of the universe, which demand social transformations.
imagen: Fire in the Lake. The image of the revolution. Thus the noble man regulates the calendar and clarifies time. The fire above and the lake below fight and destroy each other. Thus, during the course of the year a combat takes place between the light forces and the dark forces, which develops with the change of seasons. Man can control the changes of nature when he recognizes their regularity and divides the course of time accordingly. This is how order and clarity are introduced into the chaotic appearance of temporal succession and how one can adapt in advance to the demands of different times.

juicio: The cauldron Supreme fortune. Success. While “the Well” deals with the social foundations of the human community, which is like the water that serves as food for the forest, here the cultural superstructure of society is shown. Here is the forest that serves as food for the flame, the spiritual principle. Everything visible must continue its evolution and move into the invisible. Thus it receives its legitimate consecration and clarity and takes solid root in the universe as a whole. Here the culture that culminates in religion is shown. The cauldron serves divine sacrifices. The highest in the terrestrial order must be offered to divinity. But what is truly divine does not manifest itself separately from what is human. The supreme manifestation of god is found in the prophets and saints. Honoring them is the true way to honor God. The will of God that is revealed through them must be received with humility; An inner illumination and true intelligence of the universe then occurs, leading to great fortune and great success.
imagen: On the wood is the fire. The image of the cauldron. Thus the noble man secures his destiny by maintaining a correct position. The firewood is the destiny of the fire; While there is wood below, the fire burns above. The same thing happens in human life. Likewise, there is in man a destiny to which life gives strength. And when that happens, life and destiny have their right place, and destiny is fortified by putting life in intimate agreement with it. These words contain the instructions on how to cultivate life, as they are transmitted orally in the secret teaching of Chinese practical yoga.

juicio: Shock brings success. The commotion ensues: huh! huh! Laughing words ha! ha! The commotion spreads fear for a distance of a hundred miles. He does not drop the ritual spoon and chalice. The shock produced by the manifestation of God within the earth causes fear in man, but this fear of God is good because it allows him to continue with inner joy and happiness. If one has acquired the inner knowledge of what fear and trembling are, one is protected against the shocks that could be caused by outside influences. Even if the thunder rumbles to the point of spreading fear for a hundred miles around, one remains inwardly so full of calm and veneration that one does not interrupt the sacrificial rites. Such a deep and intimate gravity, on which all external reasons for fear bounce helplessly, is the spiritual disposition that the guides of men and rulers must possess.
imagen: Repeated thunder - the image of shock. Through fear and trembling the noble man puts his life in order and examines himself. Repeated thunder brings a shock that brings fear and trembling. Thus, the noble man always observes an attitude of reverence before the manifestation of God; He puts his life in order and examines his heart to see that nothing secretly opposes the divine will. Thus fear is the basis of the true art of living.

juicio: The immobility of the back so that you no longer feel your body. He enters the court and sees his people no more. Without reproaches. True rest is that where man stops when movement stops and moves when the time has come to move. Thus rest and movement are in harmony with the demands of time and then light and life are seen to be born. The hexagram is the end and the beginning of all movement. The back is mentioned because it is the seat of all the nervous centers that transmit movement. When the movement of the dorsal nerves is stopped, the ego and its restlessness are seen to a certain extent disappear. When man has achieved such inner peace he can turn to the outside world. Then he ceases to perceive in him the struggle and tumult of individual beings and consequently has the calm necessary to understand the great laws of universal phenomena and to agree with them on his conduct. Whoever acts from such depth no longer commits fouls.
imagen: The mountains gathered, the image of immobility. Thus the superior man does not let his thoughts overwhelm his situation. The heart thinks constantly. This cannot be changed, but the movement of the heart, that is, the thoughts, must be restricted to the immediate life situation. All dreams and speculations that go too far only hurt the heart.

juicio: The development. The maiden is given in marriage. Fortune. Perseverance is advantageous. The slow hesitation is what marks the succession of events at the end of which the maiden follows the man home. Various formalities must be completed for the marriage to be concluded. This progressive development can still be applied to other situations and always, in particular, to the field of correct relationships in joint work, for example, to the way in which an official is hired. Care must be taken to proceed in a harmonious progression. Haste would lead to nothing good. The same is true when one wants to influence others. Because there too, the harmonious form of progression is the formation of one's own personality. Any influence based on agitation is only short-lived. Likewise, inner evolution must take the same path if lasting results are to be obtained. The soft thing that adapts while exerting a push is the exterior that must come from inner peace. It is precisely the gradual nature of development that makes the necessary perseverance possible, since only perseverance ensures that slow progress is not lost in the sand.
imagen: On the mountain, a tree. The image of development. The noble man relies on dignity and virtue to improve customs. The tree on the mountain is visible from afar and its development modifies the landscape of the entire region. They do not appear suddenly like plants in a swampy region, but rather their growth progresses slowly. Likewise, the action on men can only be gradual. No sudden influence or unexpected awakening has any lasting effect. To make this progress in public mentality and customs, it is essential that the personality acquire influence and poise. This is obtained through meticulous and persevering work that tends towards personal development.

juicio: The marriageable maiden. Companies bring misfortune. Nothing that is advantageous. A girl who is brought into a family, without being the main wife, must conduct herself with great circumspection and reserve. You should not decide to impersonate the owner of the house because this would mean disorder and the situation would become unsustainable. This applies to all free relationships between humans. While regularly ordered relationships translate a union of duty and right, human relationships founded on inclination are based, if they are to last, on a reserve full of tact. This inclination as a principle of relationships is of great importance in all conditions of the universe, since the existence of all nature rests on the union of heaven and earth; Likewise in human beings, free inclination as a uniting principle constitutes the alpha and the omega.
imagen: Thunder over the lake: the image of the marriageable maiden. Thus the noble man understands passing things in the light of final eternity. The thunder stirs the water of the lake, which continues its momentum with resplendent waves. It is the image of the young girl who follows the man of her choice. However, every reciprocal union of humans contains a danger, that murky elements infiltrate, bringing infinite misunderstandings and displeasures. That is why it is important to never lose sight of the purpose. If one gives in to impulses, one comes together and separates following the inspiration of the moment. If, on the other hand, the purpose is always kept in mind, the pitfalls that inevitably arise in reciprocal relationships between humans will be avoided.

trigramas.inferior: Li, The oscillating thing, the flame.

juicio: Abundance succeeds. The king reaches plenitude. You should not be sad but you should be like the sun at noon. Establishing an era of greatness and supreme abundance is a destiny that is not reserved for every mortal. Being able to carry out a work of this type must be a man born to govern others because his will is directed towards what is great. Often the time of such plenitude is short. That is why a wise man would have the right to be sad at the prospect of the decline that will follow. However, such sadness does not suit him. Only a man internally free of restlessness and sadness is capable of bringing about an era of abundance. It has to be like the sun at noon that illuminates and comforts all beings under the sky.
imagen: Lightning and thunder come together: the image of abundance. The noble man decides in disputes and executes punishments. This hexagram presents a certain relationship with No. 21 “bite through” where thunder and lightning are equally gathered, but in reverse order. While there the laws were dictated with force, here they are applied and executed. Internally, clarity makes possible an exact study of the facts, and externally, the shuddering ensures the rigorous execution of punishment.

juicio: The traveler success through small things. Perseverance is advantageous for the traveler. When one is a traveler and a foreigner, one should not be sullen or pretentious. There is no circle of relationships, so that one cannot stand out. You have to be prudent and reserved, in this way you protect yourself from evil. If one is courteous to others, he will be successful. The traveler has no fixed address, the road is his home. That is why you must be careful to always be internally fair and firm, to stop only at favorable places and to deal only with good people. Then he attains good fortune and can continue on his way unmolested.
imagen: On the mountain there is fire, the image of the traveler. Thus the noble man has a clear spirit and is prudent in imposing penalties and does not prolong any dispute. When the grass catches fire on the mountain, a bright glow is perceived. However, the fire does not remain in one place but moves around looking for more fuel. It is a temporary phenomenon. Penalties and sentences should be something similar. They must be overcome quickly and not prolonged indefinitely. Prisons should be places where people stay only temporarily, as guests. They should not become permanent residences for human beings.

trigramas.superior: Sun, The Soft, the wind, the forest
trigramas.inferior: Sun, The Soft, the wind, the forest

juicio: The docile Success through small things. It is advantageous to have somewhere to go. It is advantageous to see the great man. Penetration produces gradual effects that go unnoticed. It should not be accomplished by violent means but by uninterrupted influence. These effects stand out less to the eye than those obtained by surprise, but they are more lasting and complete. To be able to act like this you must have a clearly determined goal, since only a penetrating influence always acting in the same direction achieves a result. A force of weak intensity can only produce an effect if it is placed under the authority of an eminent man who is capable of creating order.
imagen: The winds that follow. The image of what penetrates gently. Thus the noble man spreads his orders everywhere and executes his enterprises. The penetrating quality of the wind lies in its continuous character. That is why the wind becomes powerful. Take time as a means of action. It is also in this way that the thought of the ruler must penetrate the soul of the people. Furthermore, lasting action is required in the domain of explanations and orders. Only when the order has passed into the soul of the people will it be possible to count on their support. An action not previously prepared provokes only terror and repulsion.

juicio: The joyful Success. Perseverance is favorable. The joyful mood is contagious and communicative, that is why it leads to success. But it is necessary that joy be founded on firmness so as not to degenerate into something unbridled. Truth and strength must reside in the heart while gentleness is manifested in relationships with others. In this way a correct attitude is adopted towards God and towards our fellow men that leads to a certain result. In some circumstances, momentary effects are obtained through intimidation without gentleness, but they are not lasting. On the contrary, if the hearts of our fellow human beings are conquered with friendship, they will be able to accept painful things willingly and will even be able to face death without being frightened. So great is the power of joy over humans.
imagen: Lakes resting on each other. The image of joy. This is how the noble man proceeds, gathering his friends to deliberate and to act. A lake gradually evaporates and dries up. But when two lakes are in communication with each other, they do not dry up so easily since they enrich each other. The same thing happens in the domain of knowledge. Knowledge should be a life-giving and refreshing force. This is achieved only through a stimulating exchange with friends with whom to discuss and practice vital truths. Knowledge thus becomes a matter of the street and endowed with a joyful subtlety, while the science of the self-taught always has something one-sided and heavy.

juicio: The dissolution. Success. The king approaches his temple. It is advantageous to cross the great waters. Perseverance is advantageous. The text of the hexagram resembles that of T'sui, “the gathering, the recollection, ...” (n° 45). There, it was about reuniting what had been separated, like water accumulates in the lakes of the earth. Here, it is about the dispersion and dissolution of separating selfishness. The hexagram “dissolution” shows in some way the path that leads to reunion, to recollection. This explains the analogy of the texts. To overcome the selfishness that separates, man needs religious force. The joint celebration of solemn sacrifices and divine rites, which at the same time express the cohesion and social structure of the family and the state, was the means used by the great sovereigns to make hearts commune with the same emotions thanks to the created music and the pomp of the ceremonies, and to make them aware with them of the common origin of all beings. Thus the separations were overcome and all the hardnesses melted. Another way was joint work in large collective enterprises that proposed a great purpose to the will; Concentration on this objective made everything that separates fall, just like a ship crossing a great river and all the passengers are united in a common effort. In any case, only those who are free of parasitic selfishness and who remain in justice and firmness are capable of melting hardness and selfishness.
imagen: The wind blows over the water: The image of dissolution. Thus, ancient kings made sacrifices to the Lord and built temples. In autumn and winter the water coagulates and freezes. When the gentle breezes of spring arrive, the rigidity ceases and what was scattered in icebergs melts and is reunited. It is the same in the spirit of the people. Hardness and selfishness harden the heart and this rigidity separates it from all the rest. Greed and selfishness isolate humans; That is why a religious emotion is necessary that takes hold of hearts. They must dissolve, invaded by a sacred fear of eternity, feel occupied by an emotion before the intuited presence of the common creator of all beings, and experience unity thanks to the power of the feeling of communion perceived during the cult of adoration paid to divinity.

juicio: Limitation. Success. A bitter limitation should not be practiced with perseverance. Limits are painful, but they lead to success. By saving money in everyday life, we prepare ourselves to face times of hardship. By withdrawing, one avoids humiliation. Boundaries are also essential to the harmony of the world's relationships. Nature has specific limits for summer and winter, for day and night, and these are the limits that give meaning to the year. Similarly, economics, by setting precise limits on expenditure, ensures the preservation of goods and prevents harm to people. However, it is necessary to observe the measure even in the limitation. If one wanted to impose too severe limits on one's own nature, it would suffer for it. If one wanted to push the limitations imposed on others too far, they would rebel. Therefore, even in limitation, limits are necessary.
imagen: Above the lake is water: image of limitation. Thus, the noble man creates number and measure, and investigates what virtue and correct conduct are. The lake is a finite thing; The water is inexhaustible. The lake can only contain a defined amount of infinite water. This is where your property resides. Also by establishing and drawing limits in life, the individual acquires his meaning. That is why it is about establishing very clearly these limits that are like the backbone of morality. Unlimited possibilities are not what suits man. His life would then only merge into the indefinite. To become strong, you need the freely established limits that constitute duty. The individual acquires his meaning as a free spirit only when he surrounds himself with limits and freely establishes himself to respond to the command of duty.

juicio: The inner truth. Pigs and fish. Good fortune. It will be profitable to cross the great stream. Perseverance is advisable. Pigs and fish are the least spiritual animals in creation, and consequently the most difficult to influence. The force of inner truth must reach a high degree before extending its action to beings of that kind. Dealing with recalcitrant people who are difficult to influence like pigs and fish, the secret to success lies in finding the right way to approach them. First of all, we must free ourselves internally from all prejudice and practically let the other person's psyche penetrate us without restrictions. Only in this way can we approach the interlocutor internally, understand him and gain power over him. When a door has been opened in this way, the force of one's own personality can influence them. In this way there are no insurmountable obstacles and the most dangerous things can be undertaken, such as crossing the great current, and succeed. What is important to understand essentially is the foundation of inner truth. It is not identical to a mere intimacy or a secret solidarity. Such intimate solidarity can also exist among thieves. Without a doubt, even in this case it also represents a force. But it does not lead to fortune, because it is not invincible. All alliances founded on community of interests are valid to a certain extent. Where community ends, alliance also stops and the most intimate friendship often turns to hatred. Only when the foundation rests on righteousness and firmness does the bond remain strong enough to overcome all.
imagen: Wind over the lake: the image of inner truth. Thus the noble man debates criminal matters to delay the execution of sentences. The wind ripples the water because it can penetrate its interstices. The noble man, when he must judge the errors of his neighbor, seeks to penetrate his inner understanding to obtain an assessment in accordance with the circumstances. In ancient China the entire administration of justice was guided by this principle. A deep understanding that knows how to forgive was considered the supreme justice. Such an attitude was not sterile because it aimed to provoke a strong moral impression and people feared abusing such kindness. It did not emanate from weakness, but from a superior moral sense.

juicio: Preponderance of the small. Success. Perseverance is advantageous. You can do small things, you can't do big things. The flying bird brings the message. It is not good to insist on going up, it is good to stay at the bottom. Great fortune. Exceptional humility and delicacy of conscience will surely be rewarded by success. What matters in any case is that these aptitudes do not constitute an empty formalism and that they do not result from a servile nature; but that they remain linked to the dignity that is appropriate in personal conduct, so that one does not become debased. You must understand the demands of the moment and find the right complements to the deficiencies and harmful aspects of time. In any case, one should not let oneself get excited about the idea of ​​great success, because the energy for it is lacking. That is why special attention must be paid to the accompanying message of not aspiring to higher realities but being content with the lower ones. The fact that the message is provided by a bird is clear from the shape of the sign. The four strong and heavy strokes on the inside, which in the Ta Kuo hexagram “The preponderance of the great” (No. 28) are supported only by two weak strokes on the outside, offer the image of the ridge beam. Here the light carrier strokes are on the outside and are more numerous, which gives the image of a bird that soars. In any case, the bird should not be presumptuous and fly higher than the Sun, but should descend to the earth where its nest is. Thus he gives the message proclaimed by the hexagram.
imagen: Thunder over the mountain. The image of the preponderance of the small. In his conduct the noble man gives preponderance to respect; in mourning he gives preponderance to affliction; In his expenses he gives preponderance to the economy. Thunder on the mountain is different from thunder on the plain. In the mountains the thunder is much closer; while outside the mountainous regions the thunder of an ordinary storm is less audible. The noble man takes from this image the requirement to keep his duty in mind first and foremost and in a more direct and immediate way than the common man, even if his behavior appears petty to everyone. You must be exceptionally precise in your actions. In mourning, true compassion must have more value for him than external forms, and in expenses concerning his own person it must be extremely simple and unpretentious. This may appear as a strange phenomenon in the eyes of ordinary people. But the essence of this attitude is that if it is considered from the outside, it could be judged as something mediocre.

juicio: After termination. Success in small matters. Perseverance is advantageous. At the beginning fortune, at the end riots. The transition from the old era to the new has already been completed. In principle, everything is already in order and it is only in the details that success has not yet been achieved. All things are directed and move by themselves. That easily leads to relaxing and letting things go their way without worrying about them in detail. This negligence is the root of all evil. It necessarily causes the appearance of symptoms of decay. Here we have the rule that governs the usual course of history. But whoever understands it can avoid the effects thanks to infallible perseverance and prudence.
imagen: Water on fire - the image of the situation after termination. Thus the noble man reflects on misfortune and prepares in advance against it. When water is in a kettle on fire, the two elements relate to each other and the creation of energy (the production of steam) results. In any case, the resulting tension requires vigilance. If the water overflows, the fire goes out and energy is lost. If the heat is too great, the water evaporates and energy is lost to the air. The elements placed here in a reciprocal relationship are enemies of each other. Only great caution can prevent damage. The same thing happens in all junctures of life where forces balance and work harmoniously and where, as a consequence, everything is apparently in perfect order. In such circumstances, only the wise can recognize moments that contain danger and know how to avoid it thanks to the precautions taken in time.

juicio: Before termination. Success. But if the little fox puts its tail in the water before completing the crossing, there is nothing advantageous. The conditions are difficult. The task is great and full of responsibilities. It is nothing less than bringing the world from confusion to order. But it is a task that promises success, since its goal is to unite the forces currently dispersed in different directions. To achieve this, you just have to move cautiously like a young fox crossing the ice. In China, the prudence of the fox that walks on ice is proverbial. Their ears are constantly alert to the crunching of the ice and they carefully look for the safest places. A young fox, which does not yet know this caution, advances fearlessly and may fall into the water when it has almost finished crossing, getting its tail wet. Naturally, all efforts will have been in vain. Likewise, in the moments preceding the completion of a task, reflection and caution are the fundamental conditions for success.
imagen: Fire on water. The image of the conditions before fulfillment. The noble man is careful to differentiate things so that each one finds its place. When fire, which tends to rise, is above and water, which tends to descend, is below, their effects go in different directions and both remain unrelated. If we wish to achieve anything we must first investigate the nature of the forces in question and then assign each to its proper place. If arranged in the right place, they will produce the desired effect and fulfillment will be realized. But, in order to be able to dispose of external forces in an appropriate way, it is first of all necessary to adopt the correct point of view oneself. Only from that moment can you act correctly.
